confirmedGaps.description: Database guide is stale at 112 tables/27 migrations; current source and recorded deployment have 114/31.
endpoint-contracts.json still has 227 entries and omits four Excel Import routes although openapi.json and source include them.
Direct cross-origin React calls need CORS or a same-origin proxy; no CORS middleware is configured.
Role grants, coach targets, salary settings, branch drawer/accounts and plans require environment-specific configuration.
Coach payout requires the Owner actor to have an eligible own Shift as well as Owner capabilities; verify linked employee/branch setup before using payout.
Trial redemption expects a persisted GuestInvitation, but no current invitation issuance controller/BLL writer was found.
Excel preview persists source row payloads including personal fields with a 30-minute access expiry, but no deletion/retention job or API is registered.
Three legacy Classes write endpoints and freelance purchase endpoint return HTTP 410.
ClassSessionService is registered in DI but has no inspected API/BLL caller; legacy Classes writes return 410.
Historical subscription/payment import and automatic periodic-expense transfers are not part of current V1 importer/planner.
